The '''Gwen Doll''' is a [[item rarity|green]] [[miniature]].
==Acquisition==
*[[Core]]
**Randomly awarded from a [[Gift of the Traveler]]

==Notes==
*This is a miniature version of the [[April Fools' Day 2009|April Fools']] [[Gwen]].
**It is also referred to as "''[[Gwen-chan]]''" or "''[[wikipedia:Chibi (Japanese term)|Chibi]] Gwen''".
*[[Zinn]] is mentioned as maker of the ''magical micro golems'' that powers the '''Gwen Doll''' miniature.
*Like the [[Brown Rabbit (miniature)|Brown]] and [[White Rabbit]], and the [[Black Moa Chick]], this item is not prefixed by the word "''Miniature''".

==Trivia==
* This is a possible reference to the [https://photics.com/plush-gwen-contest-relaunch/ Photics.com Plush Gwen Contest].
